leads.finding: Current APHIS text describes successful containment to an 8.5-mile radius area in southeast Idaho, while separately warning that nonregulated fields cannot be assumed free of PCN.
leads.decision: Evaluate the explicit biological containment statement as a parent official-status assessment. Do not derive absence from quarantine boundaries or potato survey silence. Geographic and question-scope review remain pending.
leads.prospectivePilotExclusion: Exclude all Idaho counties initially; do not geospatially carve a radius into county negatives.

leads.finding: Current APHIS page describes the disease as found only in southern Florida. A June 17, 2025 program update documents confirmed detections and new DeSoto and Highlands quarantine areas.
leads.decision: Evaluate a dated official distribution assessment outside Florida, subject to primary wording, taxonomy/synonym, freshness and contrary-evidence review. Named confirmed detections can support presence without using the quarantine itself as biological evidence.
leads.prospectivePilotExclusion: Exclude all Florida counties from any broad negative derivation; keep 2025 detections as positive source leads.

outsideCatalogDecision: No denominator expansion to count easy negatives. Exact catalog matches were checked before admission.
